study.question: Does the nearly neutral buy-only summary-direction intervention hide a direction-by-local-norm dependence, or is native summary differentiation sufficient under the frozen recipe?
study.hypothesis: Working null: the buy-only mean-removal direction has no practically useful click advantage independent of its local norm. r0069 improved native click AUC by only 0.000004942994 while worsening click Logloss and buy AUC. A buy-only 2x2 direction/norm contrast can falsify that null if the direction consistently helps at both matched local norms, or identify a bounded interaction if only one norm works. This investigates a derivative mechanism inside the inherited compressed/task-conditioned model; it proposes no new architecture or verified novelty.

nearest_work.difference: Archived primary text, lines52-91, describes target-conditioned local activation and weighted history pooling. Those components and Dice are inherited adaptations. This proposal changes only a buy-specific backward edge and is not an exact DIN reproduction.

Resolved original v1 provenance and read https://arxiv.org/pdf/2508.11565v1, pp1-3: task-aware categorical/sequence/task interaction uses proxies and heterogeneous/homogeneous flows. This study retains the local model and changes one task summary VJP, without introducing those tokens, proxy attention or broadcasts. No effectiveness transfers from that paper and no priority claim is made.

Pinned source90bb99a60724e975ec565836266fd86dcad0039d, lines123-219, initializes sequence hubs with task masks and updates task tokens through repeated aggregation/broadcast. Our model instead keeps uniform/feedback block compression, task-specific residual adapters and context-history products; this round only completes buy-local derivative controls. Benchmark implementation is not proof of original-author equivalence.

The existing four summary derivative formulas already form this direction/norm crossing, but r0067 applies them to all four tasks. Here click/cart/fav are frozen native and only buy selects a cell. Mathematical intervention and all architecture are inherited; the new difference is task-specific attribution.

study.proposed_difference: Expose the inherited removed and native_rescaled modes for buy in constructor validation and CONFIG, freezing cart/fav and click native. Let v be the incoming derivative after live RMS, q the context query, s the summary, N=v*q and R=(v-mean(v))*q. buy_native_bridge returns N; buy_native_rescaled returns direction(N)*norm(R); buy_restored_bridge returns direction(R)*norm(N); buy_removed returns R. The inherited fallback borrows the other direction if the requested direction is zero. Query derivative stays v*s. Every cell computes the same alternatives, and eval uses q*s. No new parameters, data, task labels at inference, state, RNG, loss weights or host protocol change.
predictions: Bridge cells should reproduce r0069 native and buy-only restored predictions/metrics under the frozen seed; common-state forward/buffer and one-step parity must hold to numerical tolerance.

Working-null prediction: at both local norms, buy-only removed direction will not give a material click improvement over native direction. Predeclare 0.0001 AUC as a branch-continuation threshold, not a change to the host selection score; smaller deltas remain preliminary.

Estimate direction at native norm as AUC(restored)-AUC(native), direction at removed norm as AUC(removed)-AUC(native_rescaled), norm at native direction as AUC(native_rescaled)-AUC(native), norm at removed direction as AUC(removed)-AUC(restored). Interaction is the difference between the two direction contrasts. Use paired user-cluster intervals only if supplied by the authorized host.

All cells should have32192421 total,31793216 embedding and399205 dense parameters; equal common-state eval predictions and essentially the same operator cost. Final throughput and latency must be measured, not inferred from identical source structure.
falsifiers: The working null is falsified locally if both matched-norm direction contrasts show a material favorable click effect with appropriate uncertainty. One cell winning or repeated same-seed bridges alone does not establish a general direction mechanism.
A gain only with one norm contradicts norm-independent direction benefit; if native_rescaled gives the same gain, removing the mean is unnecessary.

Failure of bridge parity, label-identity routing, finite backward, mask invariance or source ownership blocks mechanism interpretation; it is an execution/integrity failure rather than scientific counterevidence.

No cell exceeding both bridges by0.0001 AUC ends this local branch; even a numerically best cell remains unconfirmed without paired seed/cluster evidence. Any worsening auxiliary AUC or Logloss must be reported separately.
